question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of natural gas transmission and distribution pipelines in Germany, with operator, diameter or pressure, and status?

answer.summary: Germany publishes no open national GIS dataset of gas transmission or distribution pipeline routes: § 15a (4) EnWG restricts the KO·NEP NEP-Gas-Datenbank to confidential use; § 23c (4)&(6) EnWG require only aggregate length tables and municipal presence maps; BIL requires project-specific excavation inquiries; and gasnetzkarte.de closed in 2011. Best open transmission option is SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN (1,087 DE 2-vertex segments, 31,272 km, DN & bar gap-filled, CC-BY-4.0) paired with LKD_Raw (1,037/1,045 operator_name, 2017) plus OSM/Geofabrik for exact mapped paths. Official open multi-vertex WFS geometries exist only in Hessen (no DN/bar/operator); full distribution+TSO GIS requires paid WGI.
main_caveats: No open official national GIS: § 15a (4) EnWG restricts NEP-Gas-Datenbank (confidentiality/legitimate interest), BIL handles excavation inquiries only, and gasnetzkarte.de shut down on 2011-01-01.

SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN & LKD_Raw cover transmission only (0 distribution), freeze at 2017–2021 snapshots, and store 100% of German pipes as 2-vertex straight lines between abstracted nodes (0/1,087 have >2 vertices).

IGGIELGN stripped operator_name before release (0/1,087) and gap-fills 43% of diameter_mm and 47.5% of max_pressure_bar with Median/Lasso heuristics; use LKD_Raw (1,037/1,045 raw operator_name, 2017) for operators.
Operational status is missing in SciGRID (start_year only on 25/1,087 IGGIELGN) and sparse in OSM; official Hessen WFS distinguishes Bestand vs Planung regionally without DN, bar, or operator.

Distribution networks (~740+ DSOs) publish § 23c (6) Nr. 4 EnWG municipal presence maps only; parcel-level pipe maps require signed Nutzungsantrag/login (NBB, enercity, BIL) or commercial WGI (80,924 km).
answer.confidence_reason: Verified EnWG §§ 15a/23c, BNetzA/KO·NEP/MaStR/GovData, 7 TSOs, 4 DSOs, regional OGC services (HE, RLP, HH, BE, SL, NI), SciGRID ZIPs (1,087 & 1,045 DE segments), Geofabrik Bremen PBF, WGI paid offer, and SEL PFB PDFs.

attributes.gap_note: The original rows have different scopes. Their combination has not been established as complete; original rows are retained in internal curation.

attributes.gap_note: The inherited row combines diameter and pressure; separate national coverage has not been established.

attributes.gap_note: The inherited row combines diameter and pressure; separate national coverage has not been established.

sources.name: SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN (PipeSegments)
sources.publisher: DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems (SciGRID_gas project)
sources.coverage_note: Europe + surrounding regions; Germany subset = 1,087 DE-touching segments (31,272.4 km; 1,022 DE-DE = 26,132.8 km), transmission only
sources.data_date: Release 1.0 static snapshot: PDF dated 2021-03-08, Zenodo deposited 2021-05-17, fusing 2017–2020 inputs (LKD 2017; INET/GIE/EMAP 2018–2020).
caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

example.example_request: curl -sSL -o /tmp/IGGIELGN.zip 'https://zenodo.org/records/4767098/files/IGGIELGN.zip?download=1' && unzip -p /tmp/IGGIELGN.zip data/IGGIELGN_PipeSegments.geojson | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); de=[f for f in d['features'] if 'DE' in f['properties']['country_code']]; print(len(de), round(sum(f['properties']['param']['length_km'] for f in de),1))"

sources.name: SciGRID_gas LKD_Raw (PipeSegments)
sources.publisher: DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems (from DIW Berlin lk-DEU [KKS+17])
sources.coverage_note: Germany + cross-border connectors (1,045 DE-touching segments = 26,280.7 km; 1,011 DE-DE = 24,430.9 km), transmission only
caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

problems: Why not rank 1: older 2017 DIW base (~26,281 km vs 31,272 km in IGGIELGN) and ~13% null DN / ~17% null bar; still indispensable for operator_name.

example.example_request: curl -sSL -o /tmp/LKD_Raw.zip 'https://zenodo.org/records/4750988/files/LKD_Raw.zip?download=1' && unzip -p /tmp/LKD_Raw.zip data/LKD_PipeSegments.geojson | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); de=[f for f in d['features'] if 'DE' in f['properties']['country_code']]; print(len(de), sum(1 for f in de if f['properties']['param']['operator_name']))"

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Germany extracts (Geofabrik / Ohsome)
sources.publisher: Geofabrik GmbH / HeiGIT Ohsome API / OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.format: OSM PBF (.osm.pbf; Bundesland extracts also available) / Ohsome POST API
sources.coverage_note: Nationwide Germany (4.5 GB country extract updated daily, 2026-11-14) and per-Land extracts (e.g. Bremen 20.3 MB); Ruhr bbox has 1,016.6 km mapped via Ohsome
caveats: Consult the main caveats and the complete reading traps and access evidence in the detail.

problems: Tested on 20.3 MB Bremen state extract (4.5 GB germany-latest.osm.pbf verified via HTTP 307->200 HEAD); incomplete buried coverage and sparse diameter/pressure/status tags.

example.example_request: curl -sSL -o /tmp/bremen-latest.osm.pbf 'https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/germany/bremen-latest.osm.pbf' && ogrinfo -ro -q -sql "SELECT osm_id, other_tags FROM lines WHERE man_made='pipeline' AND other_tags LIKE '%\"substance\"=>\"gas\"%'" /tmp/bremen-latest.osm.pbf
example.example_result: 3 substance=gas ways in Bremen (out of 68 man_made=pipeline ways; 3/3 operator='Gasunie Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG', 0/3 diameter/pressure/usage). Ohsome POST /v1/elements/length on Ruhr bbox (6.5,51.2,7.8,51.7 @ 2026-07-27) returned 1016560.32 m.

local_terms.meaning: High-pressure long-distance gas transmission network and its 16 operators in Germany
Regional and local gas distribution grid and operator (~740+ companies in Germany)
Biennial § 15a EnWG national transmission development plan (KO·NEP / BNetzA)
Site-specific underground utility location inquiry required before excavation (e.g. BIL eG)
Formal § 43 EnWG planning approval decree publishing approved corridor plans and technical specs
Nominal internal pipeline diameter in mm (classed A–G under § 23c EnWG) and maximum operating pressure in bar
